name: dsh-session-status
description: DSH Web GUI plugin: a global red/yellow/green status dot (sidebar footer) plus a colored browser-tab favicon (title untouched). Red = a session is blocked waiting for human input (approval / question / plan-review); yellow = a session's agent is running; green = nothing running and nothing blocked. The tab-icon mode (replace the original favicon vs. keep it with the status dot overlaid) is configurable from Settings → General and persists in the `session-status` settings namespace.
